task: Retain Granite attempts in D1 and preserve independently valid findings in incomplete benchmark responses.
nonGoals: No live inference or production changes, migrations, merges, or deployment. No committed Faherty response body or capture. Preserve the existing timeout, byte bounds and usage ceilings.

outcomes.description: Persist each bounded response and one consistent row per expected question. Preserve valid findings when rows are missing, malformed, unsupported or duplicated.
outcomes.evidence: Offline fixtures and actual local D1 replay of the saved Faherty result.

outcomes.description: Timeouts and provider errors have immutable attempt records. Storage retries are idempotent and never require another inference.

process.description: Update the existing PR, run offline CI, and independently review storage and usage safeguards.
process.evidence: Separate plan commit, review, scoped PR and measured replay.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse the existing guarded transport, byte caps and source matching. Keep the Worker path out of scope.

exitTest.reason: Database write retry and replay are deterministic benchmark operations with no agent state transfer.
